turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hello Sofia! Happy Sunday. How is your weekend going in Phoenix?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! It's going well, thanks. It is absolutely scorching hot here today, so I've been staying indoors where it's cool. I actually started my morning by whisking some stone-ground green tea powder with steamed milk to make a nice, frothy green latte.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and refreshing! Did you use your roommate's new espresso machine's milk frother for that, or do you have your own setup?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually just used a traditional bamboo whisk to get it nice and frothy, though I did steal some of her milk! It was the perfect cozy start to a day where I didn't have to make any drive or trip to work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It must be nice to have a break from the daily drive to the clinic! Are you off all weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I'm off today, thankfully. For lunch, I ended up putting together a turkey and Swiss sandwich on some of my homemade sourdough bread.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, your homemade sourdough! That sounds like an amazing lunch. How is the online Italian course coming along? Have you had any time to study today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually spent about an hour on it right after lunch! I'm practicing some basic conversational phrases now. It's tough but really fun.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Che bello! You'll be speaking like a local in no time. Speaking of future plans, how are things going with planning the summer 2028 wedding with Tom?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're taking it pretty slow since it's still a ways off, but we did look at a couple of venue websites yesterday. It's exciting to start dreaming about it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It definitely is! It's smart to start early. Are you planning on doing anything else relaxing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think Tom and I might go for a short drive in the hybrid later this evening once the sun goes down, just to get some fresh air. But for now, I'm just enjoying the AC!
